LanguageData.CC_Settings_GodAura_Tip: A god walking on the map, shown as one, has a soft halo and a carved ring under it, a glow and a ring behind it that breathe slowly, small lights rising off it in its colors, and a light that moves with it so the ground round it glows at night. Off, a god is still drawn larger, in its own colors and clothes, with its name over it.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_GodAura: A god on the map glows: a halo, rings, rising lights and a light that walks with it.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_GodMusic_Tip: When a god comes, the music fades into a beat of silence before the sting, and a track of the god's own plays after it: one of yours from Sounds/Rimfolk/Gods/(its domain)/ in Rimfolk's folder first, else one of the game's or your mods' (Anomaly's, Odyssey's, Ideology's). A god near the camera hums softly with its own sound. Off, the music goes on as it was; the sounds of a god's coming still play.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_GodMusic: The music falls silent for a god, then its own track plays.
LanguageData.CC_GodP_ConditionDesc: {NAME} is here. The sky has taken the god's color and the wind has died, and it will stay so for a few hours.
LanguageData.CC_GodP_ConditionVeiledDesc: The sky has an odd color and the wind has died. Nobody can say why, though some have their ideas.
LanguageData.CC_GodP_Card_Text_Appear: {NAME} has come. The sky took the god's color, the wind died, and everyone on the land stopped where they stood and turned to look.
LanguageData.CC_GodP_Card_Text_Appear_Veiled: Something came onto the land. The sky changed color, the wind died, and everyone stopped and turned to look. Some say it was {NAME}; others say it was only the weather.
LanguageData.CC_GodP_Card_Text_Act: {NAME} has done something here, in front of everyone.
LanguageData.CC_GodP_Card_Text_Act_Veiled: Something happened here that nobody can quite explain. Some say it was {NAME}.
LanguageData.CC_GodP_Card_Text_Reveal: The stranger was no stranger. Before everyone's eyes they grew, took on their own colors and their light, and showed themselves as {NAME}.
LanguageData.CC_GodP_Card_Text_Reveal_Veiled: The stranger changed before everyone's eyes: taller, brighter, and strange. Some say it was {NAME} all along.
LanguageData.CC_GodP_Card_Text_Depart: {NAME} has gone. The sky is clearing, and the wind will come back.
LanguageData.CC_GodP_Card_Text_Depart_Veiled: Whatever it was has gone. Some say it was {NAME}.
LanguageData.CC_GodP_Card_Text_Blessing: {NAME} has blessed this place. The light was warm, and the ground where the god stood remembers it.
LanguageData.CC_GodP_Card_Text_Blessing_Veiled: A warm light fell on this place, and the ground there remembers it. Some say it was {NAME}'s blessing.
LanguageData.CC_GodP_Card_Text_Wrath: {NAME} is angry. The sky darkened over the land, and the ground where the god stood shows it.
LanguageData.CC_GodP_Card_Text_Wrath_Veiled: The sky darkened over the land and the ground was marked. Some say {NAME} is angry.
LanguageData.CC_GodP_DevOmen: Something stirred, as if {NAME} were near.
